answer.rationale: Negotiate the expiring incumbent contract using market benchmarks and a multi-year or volume commitment as pricing leverage. This offers the best near-term path toward the 18% savings mandate while preserving proven integration and delivery continuity. Switching primary supply would be unsafe at 94% committed volume given the low-cost vendor's repeated SLA misses. Verification should confirm the strongest cost-reduction levers before commitment; achieving the full 18% remains uncertain.
